Name: Timber Perf
Description:
Faster Timberborn. Big settlements tick faster, saves load sooner, and forests draw as fast as empty land.

[h2]Next to T3MP and Performance Plus[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Both in one.[/b] T3MP's optimizations and the fixes Performance Plus lists, in one mod.
[*][b]More of its own.[/b] Plants merged into patches (a 512×512 forest goes from 11 to 107 fps), cheaper flooding checks, and the FPS counter in the map editor.
[*][b]Made for multiplayer.[/b] Every optimization gives the game's own result, so a BeaverBuddies co-op or PvP game stays the same on every player's machine.
[*][b]Ready for game updates.[/b] The loading optimizations switch off by themselves when an update changes the game's code they rely on.
[/list]

[h2]Benchmarks[/h2]
A late-game colony (213 beavers, 124 bots, about 650 buildings, 4,500 trees), on a MacBook Pro M1 Max:
[list]
[*]Paused: 59 fps without, 92 fps with
[*]Speed 1: 42 fps without, 57 fps with
[*]Speed 3: 41 fps without, 55 fps with
[*]Loading the save: 45.8 s without, 33.7 s with
[/list]
A 512×512 map with 65,000 plants in the map editor, full-screen:
[list]
[*]Paused: 11 fps without, 107 fps with
[*]Top speed: 11 fps without, 84 fps with
[/list]

BeaverBuddies Co-Op/PvP Edition and Archipelago already include it: with any of them on, the newest copy runs and the others stay off.

It turns itself off when T3MP or Performance Plus is installed: use one of them at a time.

The full list of optimizations: [url=https://github.com/FezVrasta/timberperf]github.com/FezVrasta/timberperf[/url]
